meta.name: verify-keyboard-access
meta.description: Verify that every interactive control on a page can take keyboard focus and that its primary action fires from the keyboard rather than only the mouse, and say plainly that Tab order cannot be verified today. Use when a component was hand-tested with a mouse, a custom dropdown/modal/combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查页面上的按钮、下拉框、弹窗能否只靠键盘操作,并如实说明 Tab 顺序无法自动验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果组件只用鼠标点过,或刚加了自定义下拉框、弹窗、组合框。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you tested a component with a mouse or just added a custom dropdown, modal, or combobox.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会逐个聚焦页面上的每个交互控件，确认它是否真能获得焦点，再用键盘（Enter/Space）触发主操作并等待预期结果出现；Tab 顺序今天无法验证，会报 unknown。
howto.when: 当一个组件只用鼠标手工测过、新加了自定义下拉框或弹窗等控件，或无障碍报告指出某控件无法到达时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面每个控件能不能用键盘操作
say.note: 会逐个聚焦并报告结果

say.text: 这个自定义下拉框按 Enter 没反应，用键盘验一下
say.note: 会用 press 触发并等预期结果

howto.what_en: After install, Claude focuses each interactive control on the page, confirms it takes focus, then presses Enter/Space to fire its primary action and waits for the expected result. Tab order can't be verified today, reported as unknown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a component was hand-tested with a mouse only, a custom dropdown, modal or combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

say_en.text: Check whether every control on this page works with the keyboard
say_en.note: Focuses each control and reports results

say_en.text: This custom dropdown does nothing on Enter - verify it with the keyboard
say_en.note: Presses the key and waits for the result

say_en.text: Can you verify the Tab order?
say_en.note: Tab order is reported as unknown
